name: Split screen: headline panel over the speaker
description: A panel slides down over the top half and pushes the speaker into the bottom half, with a thin divider between them. The panel is either cream with a small spaced label, a big condensed headline and an optional icon in an orange circle; solid orange with one huge white word; or near-black with a white headline.
use_when: Naming a topic, step, option or claim while the speaker keeps talking: 'option two', 'hire an editor', 'the real problem', 'step three: post it'. Use 'accent' for one punchy word, 'dark' for a serious or negative point.

headline.help: 2-4 words read best; fitted to at most two lines (accent tone: ideally one word)

kicker.help: small spaced label above the headline, e.g. 'OPTION 02' or 'STEP 3'

icon.help: optional GFX icon name shown in an orange circle (light and dark tones), e.g. 'users', 'clock', 'scissors'

tone.help: 'light' (cream panel), 'accent' (orange panel, huge white word) or 'dark' (near-black panel)
